response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to work with the lists you check most often. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture the exact configuration you want and return to it in one click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from daily priorities to quarterly planning boards, sprint backlogs, and client-specific dashboards. Views can also be shared with a team, making it easy to align everyone around the same filtered perspective without asking teammates to recreate your setup. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, tagged bugs, or a specific assignee's workload, Saved Views keeps that context ready whenever you need it. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
